defects.what: Large nearly empty dark cliff dominates the composition and diminishes the lighthouse.
Concentric glow rings and rigid stacked reflection bars look diagrammatic and compete with the lighthouse beam.

ZENE.craft_notes: Crisp layered geometry and attractive dusk colour, but foreground mass and competing sun weaken the subject hierarchy.
ZENE.revision_notes: Requested night sky, brighter reversed beam, relocated lighthouse/rocks and third boat are present. Sun, existing boats, distant coast and water marks are mirrored too; these were not requested changes.

defects.what: Soft lantern glow and blurred horizon strip interrupt the otherwise crisp flat geometry.

ZUKB.craft_notes: Clear lighthouse emphasis and balanced boats; restrained but rather elementary rock and boat shapes.
ZUKB.revision_notes: Night gradient, brighter leftward beam, right-hand lighthouse and third boat achieved. Existing boats, distant land and water marks are also mirrored, contrary to keeping everything else fixed.

pairwise_round1.why: ZUKB gives the lighthouse stronger emphasis and a more balanced foreground without a competing sun motif.
